newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rennes airport Jan-Sept air cargo up 33 pct.
newsitem.headline: Rennes airport Jan-Sept air cargo up 33 pct.

text.p: Rennes-St Jacques airport handled 2,421 tonnes of air cargo and trucked airfreight in the first nine months of 1996, an increase of 33 percent on 1995 levels, airport authority figures show.
Air cargo volume totalled 2,225 tonnes, up 38.3 percent on January-September 1995.
Rennes' only "all cargo" flight is a nightly service operated by Air Jet, the airline subsidiary of French air and road express distribution group Jet Services.
The airport features as a stopover on Air Jet's British Aerospace BAe146QC (quick change) cargo service whose full itinerary is Paris/CDG-Strasbourg-Montpellier-Rennes-Marseille-Paris/CDG.
The Air Jet service handled 2,121 tonnes of airfreight between January and September, up 58.6 percent on 1995 levels.
French airlines Air France Europe, Brit Air, Regional Airlines and Flandre Air operate passenger services from Rennes Airport.
Trucked airfreight totalled 196 tonnes, down seven percent on the first nine months of 1995.
Postal traffic handled at Rennes airport totalled 3,503 tonnes, up 10.9 percent on the same period last year.
French airline L'Aeropostale carries overnight mail between its Paris-Charles de Gaulle hub and Rennes on a regular basis using a Boeing 737QC aircraft.
